description: Enable or disable a specific node9 approver channel in the global config (~/.node9/config.json). Use this to turn individual channels on or off without touching other settings. Channels: native, browser, cloud, terminal. WEAKENING action — refused over MCP by default (a human must run it from the CLI). WARNING: disabling all approvers means node9 cannot prompt for human approval — use with care.

enabled.description: true to enable the channel, false to disable it.

name: node9_approver_set
